decision.rationale: Promoted and cleaned up. On the priority 512x512 RGB8 4:2:2 batch-8 workload, parallel MCU coefficient precompute followed by ordered entropy reduced end-to-end encode from 6.795133-6.805057 s to 0.336067-0.336740 s (95.044-95.062%, 20.21x; p=0). The other four exact cells improved 93.324-96.500%, including restart intervals 16 and 32. Every benchmark probe was deterministic, preserved its A/B codestream SHA-256, and passed both the repository decoder and independent jpeg-decoder; restart-16 additionally passed exact marker ordering. Separate serial and staged exact-matrix child processes each emitted 16 Gray/RGB sampling, quality, restart, and odd-edge records that were byte-identical and decoder-clean. After the serial route and switch were removed, the promoted single-route RTX rerun reproduced domain-separated input digest 5fbd44a6890bfe562d66709eda023f0b5b8f942f0e113824399cfd39f06fe570 and output digest 99b76d5a103ed958e4a4cdef80fb8e48cd8f2c6e28ababbf4ff787fea67ab314; the large restart batch-1/batch-8 regression also passed. The promoted route adds one dispatch and checked coefficient scratch (32,768 to 16,777,216 bytes across measured cells). That bounded cost is proportional to the representative end-to-end gain. Nsight Compute counters were unavailable because the NVIDIA driver returned ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM, so no traffic, occupancy, register, spill, or cache estimate is claimed. The corpus digest is SHA-256 over domain `P18-CUDA-JPEG-STAGED-ENCODE-CORPUS\0`, followed in workload order by each unique binary input digest framed with its little-endian u64 length. The exact-matrix digests use domains `P18-CUDA-STAGED-JPEG-EXACT-INPUTS\0` and `P18-CUDA-STAGED-JPEG-EXACT-MATRIX\0`, with each of the fixed 16 records framed by its little-endian u64 byte length.
